purpose: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity, normalize its registration type to a stable policy kind, and compare that kind with a caller-supplied allowed set.

allowedKinds.description: Comma-separated subset of llc, corporation, limited_partnership, llp, professional_corporation, other

decision_policy.policy_match: A unique strong PA registry entity was found and its normalized entity kind is in allowedKinds.
decision_policy.policy_mismatch: A unique strong PA registry entity was found and its normalized entity kind is not in allowedKinds.
decision_policy.company_not_found: No Pennsylvania registry entity candidate was found.
decision_policy.human_review: Registry evidence is unavailable, ambiguous, incomplete, or the source registration type cannot be normalized confidently.

claim_boundaries: policy_match only evaluates the caller-supplied entity-type policy
it is not legal advice or proof of good standing, ownership, authority, tax treatment, liability protection, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or regulatory compliance
